title: Pi-ATAC Protocol for Single Cell Analysis
author: Xingqi Chen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.q6gdzbw
materials: If staining is desired: stain with antibodies here.
Use heat sealer for sealing plates.

PCR: 100 wells/plate: per well: 25 µl NEBNext PCR MM, 2.5 µl Ad1, 2.5 µl Ad2 individual Primerstock concentration: 25 µM undetermined, NEB MM undetermined, Ad1 undetermined, Ad2 NEBNext High-Fidelity 2X PCR Master Mix - 250 rxns New England Biolabs Catalog #M0541L

substeps.instruction: Place tissue in a 10 cm dish filled with 10 ml PBS on ice and weigh it.
Cut tissue into small pieces using a scalpel or razor blade on ice.

steps.title: Single Cell Dissociation
steps.instruction: Dissociate the tissue into single cells.

substeps.instruction: Remove PBS from the dish, keeping the tissue on ice.
Add single cell dissociation solution (for most tissues: 200 U/ml Collagenase in HBSS-FBS (1%)) to the dish.
Transfer the solution into a 15 ml tube using a 10 ml pipet.
Incubate the 15 ml tube in a 37°C rotating incubator for 15 minutes (duration may vary by tissue type/amount).
Centrifuge (spin down) for 5 minutes at 1000 rpm.

steps.title: Cell Filtration and Washing
steps.instruction: Filter the cells and wash the pellet.

substeps.instruction: Use a glass Pasteur pipet to mechanically disrupt remaining clogs.
Transfer single cells through a 75µm strainer into a new tube (50 ml or 15 ml).
Spin down the desired amount of cells.
Add 2 ml HBSS-FBS (no collagenase) solution and spin down again.
Resuspend up to 200,000 cells in 100 µl PBS.
Fix cells for 10 minutes at room temperature (RT) using 100 µl 2% PFA.
Quench the reaction by adding 1 volume of 1.25 M Glycine (e.g., 200 µl).
Spin down the cells.
Permeabilize cells using buffer containing 0.1% NP40; do not incubate.
Immediately centrifuge for 5 minutes at 1200 rpm.
Spin down again.
For 50,000 cells, prepare a reaction mixture of 25 µl 2xTD, 22.5 µl H2O, and 2.5 µl Tn5 (Nextera DNA library preparation kit #FC-121-1030).
Incubate for 30 minutes at 37°C.
Stop the reaction by adding 40 mM EDTA (using a 1:12.5 dilution of 0.5M EDTA stock #AM92606).
Spin down for 5 minutes at 1200 rpm.
Resuspend in PBS and place on ice.

steps.title: Reverse Cross-linking and Sorting
steps.instruction: Reverse cross-links and sort cells into plates.

substeps.instruction: Add Proteinase K (200µg/µl, prepared as 1:100 from 20 mg/ml stock #EO0491) to the reverse x-link buffer.
Prepare 96-well plates with 25 µl reverse x-link buffer per well.
Set up a single cell 96 or 384 well sort on a BD FACS AriaII (or similar) using Diva software with the index sort box checked.
If stained, measure bulk controls (e.g., unstained, FMO, uniquely stained) to record fluorescence intensity.
Spin down plates immediately after sorting.
Quick-spin the plates to move all buffer to the bottom.

steps.title: DNA Recovery and Inactivation
steps.instruction: Complete the reverse cross-linking and inactivate Proteinase K.

substeps.instruction: Incubate plates at 60°C overnight (minimum 4 hours) in an incubator or PCR cycler.
Inactivate Proteinase K for 10 minutes at 80°C.

steps.title: Amplification and Cleanup
steps.instruction: Amplify the library and perform final cleanup.

substeps.instruction: Run cycling conditions: 72°C for 5 min; then 20 cycles of (98°C for 30 s, 98°C for 10 s, 63°C for 30 s, 72°C for 1 min).

Perform cleanup using MinElute vacuum (Qiagen #28204): pool wells into a reservoir, add PB (6ml per 96-well plate), wash with PE (10 ml per 96-well plate), spin down, and elute in 12 µl EB per 96-well plate.

steps.title: Quantification
steps.instruction: Quantify the library using KAPA and BioAnalyzer; perform PAGE gel cleanup if required.
